messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 > 1.5s on /v1/stream (us-west-2). SLO breach. Routing: continuous-batching path. Paging oncall -> sre_olivia
sre_olivia: Acked, paging in. pulling graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/streaming/slo?panelId=7 :eyes:
eng_oncall_jamal: I'm on it, grabbing logs from batcher pods. seeing sustained pack sizes of 20-40 and KV eviction rises
infra_ben: 3 batcher nodes in us-west-2 under backpressure, host cpu high, p99 spikes correlate with mixed-seq requests
eng_oncall_jamal: logs show scheduling starvation for short sequences when long seqs pack -> tail amplification
eng_oncall_jamal: immediate mitigation proposal:
- reduce max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 512
- enable preemptive_shed_on_stream=true
- route high-qos customers to dedicated pool (if available)
I can push config + restart batcher shards for rolling effect
cs_maya: I'll pull the list of customers hitting streaming in last hour, starting with active accounts
product_rahul: Is there confirmed customer impact? any 504s reported?
cs_maya: Two customers reported timeouts, ticket ids: CS-9981, CS-9982. Notified.
eng_oncall_jamal: deploying small change now.
deploy-bot: rollout started: config/batcher/max_batch_tokens -> 512 (canary 2/10)
eng_oncall_jamal: canary looks good, p99 down ~40% on canary. promoting to 6/10
deploy-bot: promoted to 6/10
sre_olivia: also enabled preemptive_shed flag on canary
deploy-bot: preemptive_shed -> true (canary 2/10)
eng_oncall_jamal: after 10/10 rollout, measured p95 220ms, p99 880ms on reduced-batch config
infra_ben: KV eviction rates dropping, CPU back to normal
sre_olivia: routing critical customers to dedicated pool now: routing rule applied for customer tags 'enterprise-high'
cs_maya: confirmed CS tickets updated, customers notified that we're mitigating and monitoring
product_rahul: we'll draft a short status note for affected accounts once stable
eng_oncall_jamal: root-cause notes: continuous-batching scheduler mixes long and short sequences causing large pack sizes; when long sequences stall, short seqs suffer tail amplification. follow-up: scheduler fairness and pack-size capping (INF-1234)
eng_oncall_jamal: created ticket INF-1234: BatchScheduler: fairness+max-pack heuristics; assigned to @infra_ben
sre_olivia: current status: p99 back under SLO at 0.88s for 10m window. continuing to monitor 30m before closing page :thumbsup:
cs_maya: I'll keep customer comms open until confirmed resolved
product_rahul: thanks team — please paste postmortem stub once we have timeline
sre_olivia: action items:
- INF-1234 (scheduler heuristics) @infra_ben
- Postmortem + customer timeline @eng_oncall_jamal
- CS follow-ups @cs_maya
sre_olivia: closing page in 30m if stable
eng_oncall_jamal: reassigning alert to 'monitor' channel, marking incident mitigated for now
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitor. paging silenced
